triage.note: PR #76 R1/R2: the existing escalation-choke-point case pins source tokens but does not run the browser credential state machine. A delayed successful response for key A can therefore enable and store A after the visitor has edited the field to B, and mutations that remove edit invalidation or send the raw field stay green. This case executes the shipped JavaScript with a minimal DOM/fetch harness and covers wrong, valid, edited, reloaded, verified-only extraction-header, and stale-response flows.
